title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — MD&A Liquidity and Capital Resources cash flow summary table
key_points: MD&A table "Our operating, investing and financing cash flow activities for 2022 and 2021" restates, for December 31, 2022 (In millions): Operating activities $3,565; Investing activities $1,999; Financing activities $(3,264); Net increase in cash and cash equivalents $2,300.
The MD&A figures match the audited consolidated statement of cash flows to the dollar for all three activity categories.
As of December 31, 2022, cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments were $5.9 billion versus $3.6 billion as of December 25, 2021.

The increase in cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments was attributed primarily to $2.4 billion of cash and $1.6 billion of short-term investments acquired from the Xilinx acquisition, $1.0 billion from the debt issuance of the 3.924% Notes and 4.393% Notes, and cash flows from operations, partially offset by stock repurchases and cash paid for the Pensando acquisition.

Aggregate principal debt obligations were $2.5 billion as of December 31, 2022 (vs $313 million at December 25, 2021), consisting primarily of $1.5 billion of assumed Xilinx Notes and $1.0 billion of 3.924%/4.393% Notes issued during the year; $312 million of 7.50% Senior Notes were repaid in August 2022.
No funds were drawn from the $3.0 billion five-year unsecured revolving credit facility during the year ended December 31, 2022, and no commercial paper was outstanding as of December 31, 2022.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Note 12, Common Stock and Stock-Based Compensation (stock repurchase program)
key_points: During the year ended December 31, 2022, the Company repurchased 36.3 million shares of its common stock under the Repurchase Program for $3.7 billion.
As of December 31, 2022, $6.5 billion remained available for future stock repurchases under the program.
In February 2022 the Board approved a new repurchase program to purchase up to $8 billion of outstanding common stock, in addition to the existing $4 billion program approved in May 2021.

Shares of common stock outstanding rose from 1,207 million at the beginning of 2022 to 1,612 million at the end of 2022, including 429 million shares issued in the acquisition of Xilinx and 36 million repurchased.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Note 5 Business Combinations: Xilinx acquisition consideration and purchase price allocation
key_points: The Xilinx acquisition closed February 14, 2022 for total purchase consideration of $48.8 billion ($46.4 billion, net of cash acquired of $2.4 billion).

Xilinx consideration consisted of $48.5 billion of fair value of 429 million AMD common shares issued to Xilinx stockholders plus $275 million of fair value of replacement equity awards attributable to pre-combination services; share value based on the February 11, 2022 closing price of $113.18 per share.

Xilinx purchase price allocation (in millions): Cash and cash equivalents 2,366; Short-term investments 1,582; Accounts receivable 299; Inventories 539; Property and equipment 692; Acquisition-related intangibles 27,308; Total Assets 33,341; Long-term debt 1,474; Deferred tax liabilities 4,346; Total Liabilities 7,332; Fair value of net assets acquired 26,009; Goodwill 22,784; Total purchase consideration 48,793.
Xilinx acquired intangibles included developed technology $12,295M (16-year life) and customer relationships $12,290M (14-year life), plus IPR&D of $970M not subject to amortization.
Goodwill from the Xilinx acquisition was assigned to the Embedded and Data Center segments and is not expected to be deductible for income tax purposes.

The purchase consideration consisted of $48.5 billion of fair value of 429 million shares of the Company's common stock issued to Xilinx stockholders and $275 million of fair value of replacement equity awards attributable to services rendered pre-combination.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Note 12 Common Stock: stock repurchase program and share activity
key_points: In May 2021 the Board approved a stock repurchase program authorizing up to $4 billion of common stock (Existing Repurchase Program); in February 2022 the Board approved an additional program to purchase up to $8 billion of outstanding common stock.
During the year ended December 31, 2022, AMD repurchased 36.3 million shares under the Repurchase Program for $3.7 billion.
As of December 31, 2022, $6.5 billion remained available for future stock repurchases under the program, which has no termination date.

Shares of common stock outstanding rose from 1,207 million to 1,612 million during FY2022, including 429 million shares issued in the Xilinx acquisition and a reduction of 36 million shares from repurchases and 5 million from tax-withholding repurchases.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Item 5 Issuer Purchases of Equity Securities (quarterly repurchase detail)
key_points: FY2022 quarterly repurchases: Dec 26, 2021–Mar 26, 2022 15,785,806 shares at $121.03 average; Mar 27–Jun 25, 2022 10,159,900 shares at $90.58; Jun 26–Sep 24, 2022 6,895,972 shares at $89.52; Sep 25–Dec 31, 2022 3,484,459 shares at $71.75; total 36,326,137 shares.
Remaining authorization declined from $8,327 million after Q1 to $6,540 million at Dec 31, 2022.

During fiscal year 2022 AMD withheld 5 million shares as payment of withholding taxes on vesting/exercise of equity awards; these are treated as common stock repurchases but are not under the authorized repurchase plan.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Note 8 Debt and Revolving Credit Facility (note issuance and repayment detail)
key_points: On June 9, 2022 AMD issued $1.0 billion aggregate principal of senior notes: $500 million of 3.924% Senior Notes due 2032 and $500 million of 4.393% Senior Notes due 2052; interest payable semi-annually on June 1 and December 1, commencing December 1, 2022.
In August 2022 AMD repaid its $312 million 7.50% Senior Notes due 2022 (issued August 15, 2012 as $500 million).
In connection with the Xilinx acquisition AMD assumed $1.5 billion aggregate principal of Xilinx's 2.950% Notes due 2024 ($750M) and 2.375% Notes due 2030 ($750M) — the 'Assumed Xilinx Notes'.
Total debt principal was $2,501 million at Dec 31, 2022 versus $313 million at Dec 25, 2021; total debt net of unamortized discount and issuance costs was $2,467 million.
No outstanding borrowings under the $3.0 billion revolving credit facility as of December 31, 2022.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — MD&A 对经营/投资/筹资现金流变动的管理层解释
key_points: FY2022 经营活动净流入 36 亿美元，主要来自 13 亿美元净利润，经 41 亿美元非现金调整，以及营运资产负债变动带来的 18 亿美元净流出。
FY2021 经营活动净流入 35 亿美元，主要来自 32 亿美元净利润，经 11 亿美元非现金调整，以及 7.74 亿美元营运资产负债净流出。
FY2021 投资活动净流出 6.86 亿美元，主要因购买短期投资 21 亿美元及购置物业设备 3.01 亿美元，部分被短期投资到期收回 17 亿美元抵消。
FY2022 筹资活动净流出 33 亿美元，主要为回购计划下 37 亿美元普通股回购、4.06 亿美元代扣税款回购、3.12 亿美元偿债，部分被 9.91 亿美元发债和 1.67 亿美元员工购股抵消。
FY2021 筹资活动净流出 19 亿美元，主要为 18 亿美元普通股回购和 2.37 亿美元代扣税款回购，部分被 1.04 亿美元员工购股抵消。
FY2022 营运资产变动中，预付费用及其他资产增加主要源于长期供应协议下的预付款；应付账款增加 9.31 亿美元主要源于对供应商付款时点；应计负债及其他增加 5.46 亿美元主要源于客户相关应计项上升。
FY2021 应收账款增加 6.40 亿美元，主要因 2021 年第四季度收入较 2020 年第四季度高 16 亿美元；存货增加 5.56 亿美元源于为支持客户需求持续增加产品备货。

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Note 12 Common Stock（回购计划授权与执行）
key_points: 2021 年 5 月董事会批准最高 40 亿美元普通股回购计划（Existing Repurchase Program）；2022 年 2 月董事会在此基础上新增批准最高 80 亿美元回购计划，合称 Repurchase Program。
FY2022 公司依回购计划回购 3,630 万股普通股，金额 37 亿美元；截至 2022-12-31 该计划剩余可用额度 65 亿美元。
该回购计划不构成强制回购义务，无终止日期，可随时暂停或终止。
普通股流通股数从期初 1,207 百万股增至期末 1,612 百万股，其中因 Xilinx 收购发行 429 百万股，回购减少 36 百万股。
raw_excerpt: In May 2021, the Company's Board of Directors approved a stock repurchase program authorizing up to $4 billion of the Company's common stock (Existing Repurchase Program). In February 2022, the Company's Board of Directors approved a new stock repurchase program in addition to the Existing Repurchase Program to purchase up to $8 billion of outstanding common stock in the open market … During the year ended December 31, 2022, the Company repurchased 36.3 million shares of its common stock under the Repurchase Program for $3.7 billion. As of December 31, 2022, $6.5 billion remained available for future stock repurchases under this program.
